relationships.subject: curcumin
relationships.evidence_quote: Curcumin downregulates the expression of COX-2 and thus decreases the release of prostaglandins [29]

relationships.subject: curcumin
relationships.evidence_quote: Curcumin also helps in reducing inflammation by hindering the activation of nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-κB)

relationships.subject: NF-κB
relationships.evidence_quote: the downregulation of NF-κB can also lead to the elevation of antioxidant responses by activation of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NRF2) [36]

relationships.subject: curcumin
relationships.evidence_quote: Consumption of curcumin also improves muscle performance and has an anti-inflammatory effect, downregulating the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including TNF-α, IL-6, and IL-8.

key_findings: Review: curcumin reduces muscle soreness, CK and inflammatory markers after exercise-induced muscle damage
